cardOverview.overviewText: A RuPay Wave card offering contactless transactions, cashback on utility and lifestyle spends, and simple benefits for domestic users.

items.child: Unlock 10% cashback on your first 5 UPI transactions made within the first 30 days of card issuance (upto Rs 200/-).
